items.title: While we argue whether AI can code, some developers went 10x
items.summary: We at DevGhost looked at the public Git history of microsoft/vscode and TryGhost/Ghost. For several developers, our estimates show a 5–21× jump in output over a year.The interesting part is what happened inside those PRs.VS Code can add a Copilot co-author trailer automatically, so we checked ...
